paite: Huan Benjamin mi Bikri tapa Sheba, Belial mi khat ana om hi. Ama'n pengkul amut a, "David ah tantuan i nei kei ua, Jesse tapa ah leng gouluah ding i nei sam kei, Israel mite aw, na puanin lam chiat uah pai un," achi hi.
heading: Sheba Helna

paite: Huchi in Israel mi tengteng in David azuih uh alehngatsan ua, Bikri tapa Sheba azuita uhi. Judah mite'n Jordan a pan Jerusalem pha in akumpipa uh alen tinten uhi.
Jerusalem a a-inn ah David ahong pai hi. Kumpipa'n numei sawm ameite inn ngak dia akoihte api a, inn khat ah akhum a, anek ding uh pia in avak a, himahleh amaute akithuahpih kei hi.
Kumpipa'n Amasa kiang ah, "Ni thum sung in Judah mite hon sapkhawmsak inla, nang leng hong om sam in," achi hi.
Huchi in Amasa leng Judah mite samkhawm ding in akuan hi. Himahleh ahun sehsak sang in ava tam sawt zawta hi.

David in Abishai kiang ah, "Bikri tapa Sheba in Absalom sang in i poi uh akhoihzaw dia hia? Na toupa mite pi inla delh un. Huchi lou in zaw khokulh nei ah alut man dia, muh phak louh in i khahsuah kha ding," achi hi.
Huchi in Joab mite, Kereth mite, Pelet mite leh amihat tengteng un amah azuikheta uh. Jerusalem a pan Bikri tapa Sheba delh ding in apawtkhia uhi.
Gibeon a suangpi omna ava tun un, Amasa in amaute ana dawn hi. Joab in kidouna van asilh a, atung ah namsau apai toh kawnggak ah akuah hi. Mailam a apai kawm in huai namsau aphawi hi.
Joab in Amasa kiang ah, Unaupa, "Na hoih tadih na maw?" achi hi. Huai khit in Joab in Amasa tawp ding in akhut taklam in akhamul aman hi.

Himahleh Amasa in Joab in atawi namsau alimsak kei hi. Joab in agil ah adawt a, agilzangte lei ah atolhkhe zelzul a, adawt tuan nawn kei hi. Huchi in asita hi. Joab leh a-unaupa Abishai in Bikri tapa Sheba adelh uhi.
Akiang ah Joab mite lak a tangval khat adingh a, "Joab lam a pang leh David lam a pang peuhmah in Joab zui hen," achi hi.

Amasa bel lamlian laitak ah si a kidiah in ana lum hi. Huai mi'n mi tengteng dingh dide amuh in lamlian a pan Amasa luang gamlak ah asuan a, akiang a hong pai peuhmah khawl zel a amuh ziak in puan in atuam hi.
Lamlian a pan suankhiak ahih nung in Bikri tapa Sheba delh ding in mi tengteng in Joab azui uhi.
Abel leh Beth-maaka pha in Israel nam tengteng leh Ber mi tengteng atawn vek a; amau akikaikhawm ua amah azuita uhi.
Beth-maaka a Abel ah amah a-um ua; kho zulzul ah lei achiang ua, kulh zul ah adingh uhi. Joab kiang a mi om tengteng in chimsak ding in kulh akhoh ok-ok uhi.
Huchi in khua a pan numei pil khat ahong kikou a, "Ngai un, ngai un; Joab kiang ah, hong pai nai in, na kiang ah thu ka gen ding, va chi un," achi hi.
Akiang ava naihtak in numei in, "Joab na hi hia?" achi hi. Ama'n, "Hi e," chi in adawng hi. Huchi in akiang ah, "Na sikhanu thugen ngaikhe dih," achi a, ama'n, "Ka ngaikhia hi," chi in adawng hi.
Huai numei in, "Nidanglai in Abel ah akikum ngeingei ding uh," achi zel uh. Huchibang in thu atawpsak zel uhi.
Kei Israel lak a kituah ut leh muanhuai mite lak a khat ka hi. Nang zaw Israel khua, akho bulpi pen hihsiat tum na hi lim ve. Bangziak a TOUPA gou nawmvalh tum na hia? achi hi.
Joab in adawng a, "Huchibang ahi zenzen kei. Nawmvalh hiam, hihsiat hiam ka tum kei himhim hi.

Huchibang thu ahi kei. Ephraim tanggam a mi Bikri tapa amin Sheba in kumpipa kalh in, David hilhial kalh in akhut alik hi. Amah hon pekhe le uchin khua ka pawtsan mai ding,” achi hi. Numei in Joab kiang ah, "Ngai in, kulh a pan alutang lotkhiak ahi ding," achi hi.

Huchi in numei in apilna in mi tengteng kiang ah ava pai a, Bikri tapa Sheba lutang atan ua, Joab kiang ah alawnkhia uhi. Huchi in pengkul amut a, amau puanin chiat zuan in khua a pan apaita uhi. Jerusalem ah kumpipa kiang ah Joab apaikikta hi.
Israel sepaih tengteng heutu Joab ahi a; Jehoiada tapa Benaiah ahihleh Kereth mi leh Pelet mite heutu ahi.
heading: David Miliante

paite: Adoram phutluih nasem dia goih a omte heutu ahi a, Ahilud tapa Jehoshaphat tanchin gelhmi ahi.
Sheva, laigelhmi ahi a; Zadok leh Abiathar ahihleh siampute ahi uh.
Jair mi Ira leng David vaihawmtu lian ahi.
